title: Social life & relationships
description: Hand-selected conversational vocabulary with contextual Mandarin examples.

cards.english: Not as good as; better to
to be convinced (that sth is true); to believe; to accept sth as true
Go to work; be at work
Is not; am not; are not
Know how to; will; be likely to
Again; then, for a future action
to exchange; to change (clothes etc); to substitute
(not only ...) but also; moreover; in addition
to speak; to explain; to negotiate

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ bàn yè bèi diàn huà chǎo xǐng le.
grammar.english: A phone call woke me in the middle of the night.

grammar.pinyin: Měi tiān yùn dòng yǒu hěn duō hǎo chu.
grammar.english: Exercising every day has many benefits.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gǎn xiè nǐ de bāng zhù.
grammar.english: I'm very grateful for your help.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ píng cháng dōu zuò dì tiě shàng bān.
grammar.english: I usually commute by metro.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ bù pà gāo, dàn shì pà diào xià lai.
grammar.english: I'm not afraid of heights, but I am afraid of falling.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ mǎi ge lǐ wù.
grammar.english: I'd like to buy you a present.

grammar.pinyin: Tā yǐ jīng dā ying bāng wǒ le.
grammar.english: He has already agreed to help me.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè lǐ wǎn shang hěn ān jìng.
grammar.english: It's very quiet here in the evenings.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, wǒ huì zhù yì ān quán.
grammar.english: Don't worry; I'll be careful about safety.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zhǎo shén me yàng de fáng zi?
grammar.english: What kind of home are you looking for?

grammar.pinyin: Tā kàn qi lai hěn nián qīng.
grammar.english: He looks very young.

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǒ qǐng kè, nǐ xiǎng chī shén me?
grammar.english: I'm treating today; what do you want to eat?

grammar.pinyin: Yǒu wèn tí jiù suí shí lián xì wǒ.
grammar.english: Contact me anytime if you have a question.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men dǎ suàn zhōu mò qù tú bù.
grammar.english: We're planning to hike this weekend.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men quán jiā dōu xǐ huan lǚ xíng.
grammar.english: Everyone in our family enjoys traveling.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ duì zhè ge jié guǒ mǎn yì ma?
grammar.english: Are you satisfied with the result?

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān zài dì tiě pèng dào péng you.
grammar.english: I ran into a friend on the metro yesterday.

grammar.pinyin: Guì de dōng xi bù yī dìng hǎo.
grammar.english: Expensive things aren't necessarily good.

grammar.pinyin: Tā jué de ài qíng xū yào xìn rèn.
grammar.english: He thinks romantic love requires trust.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge bàn fǎ bù xíng, wǒ men huàn yī ge.
grammar.english: This approach won't work; let's try another.

grammar.pinyin: Tiān hū rán xià yǔ le.
grammar.english: Suddenly it started to rain.

grammar.markup: {我}{喜欢}{运动}，{比如}{攀岩}{和}{游泳}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan yùn dòng, bǐ rú pān yán hé yóu yǒng.
grammar.english: I like sports such as climbing and swimming.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ kě yǐ zuò dào.
grammar.english: I believe you can do it.

grammar.pinyin: Tā de tài du hěn rèn zhēn.
grammar.english: His attitude is very serious.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ bù shì gù yì de.
grammar.english: I didn't do it on purpose.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de rén duì yóu kè hěn yǒu hǎo.
grammar.english: People here are very friendly to visitors.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ de ài ren jīn tiān jiā bān.
grammar.english: My spouse is working overtime today.

grammar.pinyin: Tā bù dàn huì zhōng wén, ér qiě huì yīng yǔ.
grammar.english: He speaks not only Chinese but also English.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ shí zai tài lèi le.
grammar.english: I'm really too tired.

grammar.pinyin: Tā jiǎng le yī ge xiào hua.
grammar.english: He told a joke.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn miàn le.
grammar.english: We haven't seen each other for ages.

grammar.pinyin: Péng you shēng bìng le, wǒ hěn guān xīn tā.
grammar.english: My friend is sick, and I'm concerned about him.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge shí jiān bù gòu.
grammar.english: There isn't enough time.

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān xià yǔ, bù rú zài jiā xiū xi ba.
grammar.english: It's raining today; we might as well stay home.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān bù tài xiǎng chū mén.
grammar.english: I don't really feel like going out today.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de rén hěn rè qíng.
grammar.english: The people here are very welcoming.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men bù jiǔ jiù huì jiàn miàn.
grammar.english: We'll see each other soon.

grammar.pinyin: Tā tū rán gào su wǒ yī ge xiāo xi.
grammar.english: He suddenly told me some news.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān yǒu diǎn nán shòu, xiǎng xiū xi.
grammar.english: I feel a bit unwell today and want to rest.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge yùn dòng zuì jìn hěn liú xíng.
grammar.english: This sport has become popular recently.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān shāng liang yí xià zài jué dìng.
grammar.english: Let's discuss it before deciding.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān xīn qíng bú cuò.
grammar.english: I'm in a pretty good mood today.
